notes: Stories added for EVAL-CT-M1 (Trial Phase scoring).

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for trial phase scoring
Added core logic story for phase scoring
Added API integration story via facade

EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define normalized schema for clinical trial phase (I, II, III, IV, Unknown) and corresponding scoring weights used as maturity signal in evaluation.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement backend logic to extract trial phase from ClinicalTrials.gov response, normalize values, and assign a score reflecting trial maturity (e.g., Phase III/IV higher than Phase I).

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Score via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate phase scoring output into evaluate_care_facade so trial results include phase label and computed score in response payload.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Trial Phase Scoring
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests for phase normalization and scoring logic, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov response to facade output.
